title: PR 5B — inventory sales: COGS at invoice creation, void/edit reversal, COGS by period, shrinkage write-off

goals.text: Fake-ledger golden values: an invoice line with itemId (trackInventory on) posts stock_sale DR cogs | CR 1500 at weighted average, sourceId = the invoice line id, exactly once (replay posts nothing); lines without itemId or tenants with tracking off touch no stock; Float quantities convert exactly; AU books COGS to 5000, US/CA to 5990 (P&L per jurisdiction account); selling the last unit takes the remainder (value exactly 0 at qty 0); selling past on-hand flags negative and the next purchase trues up; void posts stock_sale_void restoring exactly; a qty edit reverses and reposts (stock_sale_edit_reverse + stock_sale line:rev); COGS by month/quarter nets voids; cross-tenant item ids are 404; a shrinkage write-off with a reason books 5995.

Real Next handlers (mutation-checked on file copies: removing the call site in create, void or PATCH each fails this file): POST invoices relieves stock for item lines and refuses a foreign itemId with 404 and nothing written; POST invoices/:id/void returns stock and 1500/COGS/revenue to baseline; PATCH invoices/:id { lines } on a draft re-posts revenue (invoice_edit_reverse + invoice_edit) and COGS, a later void clears everything; a sent invoice refuses line edits (422); GET inventory/cogs reports the month net of voids.

New Invoice item picker (only when trackInventory is on; fills description + sale price; the POST carries itemId), Items page COGS-by-quarter section and Write off dialog (positive qty + required reason → negative adjust), chat skill query-cogs (before general-question, gated on trackInventory, nets voids, states the period, en/fr-CA/zh-CN catalog) reached through the real consultation triage for en/fr-CA/zh-CN phrasings.

Full-journal seeded property test (150 sequences, US/CA/AU tenants): bills (taxed, at_entry/at_payment, item lines), payments, payment voids, bill voids, opening stock, invoice stock sales / qty edits / voids, shrinkage adjustments and payroll entries keep Σdr = Σcr, journal 2000 = Σ open at_entry bills, and journal 1500 = Σ item values. It found two PR 5A defects, fixed here and mutation-checked: an at_payment item bill re-paid after a voided payment debited 1500 with no stock movement (purchase movements are now generation-keyed), and a relief of a negative stock value changed the sub-ledger with no journal (relief is clamped at 0).
Architecture, product, workflows and user-story docs describe the shipped programme (bills/AP, tax codes, inventory incl. sales/COGS, payroll employees and pay-run drafts) and the journal invariant.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change (AbInvoiceLine.itemId and the inventory tables shipped in 5A). Invoices created meanwhile keep balanced stock_sale entries (DR cogs | CR 1500) and their movements; after a revert, voiding such an invoice reverses revenue but NOT its COGS — reverse those with an items/:id/adjust (+qty at the sold value) or re-apply the PR before voiding. Edited drafts keep their invoice_edit entries (balanced; invoice.journalEntryId points at the live one). Set trackInventory=false to stop new COGS postings without a revert.
